xbrli:xbrl.in-bse-fin:NameOfTheCompany: Indian Railway Catering And Tourism Corporation Limited
xbrli:xbrl.in-bse-fin:DisclosureOfNotesOnFinancialR: 1. UFR reviewed by AC and approved by BoD on 11.02.25. Statutory Auditors have conducted limited review of unaudited FR. 2. FR prepared as per Ind-AS u/s 133 of Co. Act, 2013 read with Co. (Ind AS) Rules, 2015. 3. RB vide CC60 of 2019 reg. inc. in catg tariff for post and pre-paid trains. Effect of inc. of License Fee from 18.11.2019 to 22.032020 (for postpaid trains) and 27.11.21 to 31.12.23 (for post and prepaid trains) has not been recognized as the matter is sub-judice. 4. As per T&C of tender, for 4 PPP RN plants, DCOs to be reimbursed GST on sales (net of ITC) availed by them. As per the information made available by DCOs, Rs. 292.62 Lac accounted during the nine months ended 31.12.2024 & Rs. 364.83 lac accounted during FY 2023-24. DCOs represented against the claim for ITC. Being examined by the Mgt. 5. NAA issued notice dt 25.02.22 for profiteering amount of Rs.5041.44 lac under CGST Act for not passing benefit of tax reduction to consumers. CCI empowered to adjudicate the matter. However, no communication received from CCI in this matter till date. 6. Certain Licensees invoked arbitration for compensation of diff. rates of regular & combo meal provided under CCs issued by IR and claimed price of welcome drink from 2014 till date. Arbitrator awarded Rs.7471.65 Lac (approx.) in 13 petitions from Jan 2015 to Mar 2020. On record claimant never claimed said amount while submitting invoices for services rendered. Services provided to passengers of IR & amt. so paid is req. to be reimbursed to IRCTC by IR. Co. filed objection & Hon’ble HC, Delhi directed Co. to deposit amt. to stay execution of Arbitral Award. Deposited a BG to tune of Rs.8471.65 Lac to stay execution of said award. The Hon’ble HC, Delhi set aside & quashed the award of Rs.4200 Lakhs against IRCTC while upholding the smaller claim of Rs.3200 lakhs. the Co. & licensee both have separately filed petitions u/s 37 of Arbitration & Conciliation Act, 1996 for challenging the impugned judgment . The judgment in the said matter pronounced on 10.02.25 but detailed directives issued by Court in said judgment is awaited. 7. (a) For 09 months ended 31.12.24, Exceptional items represent Rs. 220.72 lakhs towards the reversal of RU, Stabling & other charges waived off on GC train by KTDC for the pre. FY 23 & 24. (b) For PY FY 24, net expense on account of Exceptional items amounting Rs.5853.03 Lac includes: (i) Rs.5126.20 Lac being prov. made towards revised fixed, variable & Custody charges for 2 Tejas trains w.e.f. 13.08.21 to 31.03.23 in line with letter received from MOR even though Co. made rep. to RB for waiver amount, (ii) Rs.1451.24 Lac being provision made towards the diff. amt of profit sharing @25% (40%-15%) up 31.03.23 on profits of RN plants operated on PPP model and (iii) Rs.724.41 Lac being excess prov. written back for PY relating to exp.. 8. BOD declared 2nd Interim Dividend of Rs.3/- per share for FY 2024-25 9. The fig. for PY/periods regrouped/reclassified/restated, wherever considered necessary. 10. Since, the subsidiary Company was incorporated on 10.02.24 & did not exist during the quarter & 9 months ended 31.12.23 and hence, the fig. for quarter & 09 months ended 31.12.23 pertain to parent company only.
